_doc: One-line, source-backed context for a constructor inside its franchise lineage (team pages, lineage timeline). Editorial continuity only: each constructor name keeps its own sporting record. No transaction prices. Sources stay here (owner rule 2026-10-02: no per-fact source links on pages).

wp-stewart-gp.title: Stewart Grand Prix
wp-stewart-gp.fact: founded by Jackie Stewart and his son Paul Stewart in 1996; competed as the Ford works-supported team 1997-1999; at the end of 1999 Ford bought the team outright and it was renamed Jaguar Racing; in 2004 Jaguar Racing was sold to Red Bull and rebranded Red Bull Racing in 2005

wp-jaguar-f1.title: Jaguar in Formula One
wp-jaguar-f1.fact: Ford, Jaguar's then-parent company, purchased Stewart Grand Prix in June 1999 and renamed it Jaguar; the team operated 2000-2004; Ford sold it to Red Bull at the end of 2004

stewart.text: Founded by Jackie and Paul Stewart and run as Ford's works-supported team.

jaguar.text: Ford bought the Stewart team in 1999 and raced it under its Jaguar brand.

red-bull.text: Red Bull bought the team from Ford at the end of 2004 and renamed it Red Bull Racing for 2005.
